description: The user's scheduled runs: one data tool with its arguments that Whizbrew runs on its own side at a cadence (hourly, daily, every monday at 9:00 UTC...), whatever agent or machine is open, charged like the same call by hand, and the same for every agent of this account. Its answer's `show` holds the rows laid out for a terminal: the user cannot see tool results, so put `show` in your reply as it is, then add your own remarks. action list: every schedule with its next and last run (free). action create {tool, arguments, cadence, name, cap_per_run_usd?}: send it first without confirmed: it creates nothing and answers the one question to ask the user (cadence, price, cap per run); send it again with confirmed: true only after the user said yes to that question. After a job the user may want again, offer it as a question with options (daily / weekly / no); a skill tool's answer already carries it in ask_user. action update {id, cadence?, tool?, arguments?, name?, cap_per_run_usd?, status: active|paused}: one call changes what it does, its cadence, or pauses it. action delete {id}. action runs {id, new_only?}: its latest stored result (free), each run with how many rows were new, `new` and `show` with the rows not in the run before first; new_only: true answers those rows only; its data's schedule_stopped / schedule_note say what a run did not read, schedule_next the call for it (for you, not the user). When the user asks what is new, or for the latest results of something they run on a schedule, in any chat: action list finds it, then runs. A call_tool with the same tool and arguments answers the latest stored result first (free, with its date); max_age_s: 0 runs it fresh. At most 10 schedules, hourly at the most.

action.description: What to do: list (every schedule, free), create (send it first without confirmed, then again with confirmed: true after the user's yes), update, delete, or runs (one schedule's stored results, free)

arguments.description: The tool's input, as describe_tools shows it

cadence.description: hourly | daily | weekly | every 6 hours | every monday | daily at 09:00 (UTC)

cap_per_run_usd.description: The most one run may cost (default: five calls' price)

confirmed.description: true only after the user said yes to create's question

name.description: A short name the user recognises, e.g. top skincare creators

new_only.description: runs only: true answers only the rows that were not in the run before (a first run: all)

status.description: update only: paused stops its runs and charges, active runs it at its cadence again

name: schedule
title: Scheduled runs
